scenes.name: Dot flash
scenes.description: Dots, dice faces and finger patterns that appear briefly and then hide.

scenes.name: Counters
scenes.description: Free two-colour counters and toy objects to drag, line up, group and share.

scenes.name: Ten-frame
scenes.description: Single or double five/ten-frames that counters snap into, filling left to right.

scenes.name: Bead frame
scenes.description: Two-row rekenrek with 5 red and 5 white beads per row.

scenes.name: Part-whole
scenes.description: Whole circle with two or more part circles; also the Japanese cherry split diagram.

scenes.name: Number track
scenes.description: Numbered squares and cube staircases where each step is one more.

scenes.name: Number line
scenes.description: Marked, empty, vertical or zoomable number line with animated hops.

scenes.name: Hundred square
scenes.description: 1-100 grid with highlighting, sliding windows and colour patterns.

scenes.name: Base-10 blocks
scenes.description: Ones cubes, ten rods, hundred flats and thousand cubes.

scenes.name: Place-value chart
scenes.description: Columns with place-value counters and a digit slider for x10 and /10.

scenes.name: Arrays
scenes.description: Rows and columns of objects that rotate, split and regroup.

scenes.name: Bar model
scenes.description: Bars that grow out of real objects, split into equal parts and compare lengths.

scenes.name: Fraction strips
scenes.description: Fraction strips, fraction wall, circles and folding paper.

scenes.name: Area model
scenes.description: Rectangle split into parts whose areas show products.

scenes.name: Balance
scenes.description: A beam balance that tips when sides are unequal and levels when equal.

scenes.name: Clock
scenes.description: Geared analogue clock linked to a digital display and a day timeline.

scenes.name: Money
scenes.description: UK coins and notes, purse, shop shelf and till.

scenes.name: Measuring lab
scenes.description: Ruler, tape, scales, jugs and thermometer with live readings.

scenes.name: Shape lab
scenes.description: 2D shapes, tangrams, geoboard, mirror line and turning shapes.

scenes.name: 3D solids
scenes.description: Rotatable solids that unfold into nets and show faces, edges, vertices.

scenes.name: Coordinate grid
scenes.description: Grid with plotted points and shapes that translate, reflect, rotate, enlarge.

scenes.name: Angle turner
scenes.description: Two arms that turn from a point, a sweeping arc and a protractor.

scenes.name: Chart builder
scenes.description: Data objects that fly into tallies, pictograms, bars, lines and pies.

scenes.name: Function machine
scenes.description: A machine that takes numbers in and sends results out by a rule.

scenes.name: Algebra tiles
scenes.description: x², x and unit tiles, positive and negative, forming rectangles.

scenes.name: Graph plotter
scenes.description: Coordinate plane where tables of values become points and lines.

scenes.name: Chance lab
scenes.description: Spinners, dice, bags of counters, simulations and tree diagrams.

scenes.name: Soroban
scenes.description: Japanese abacus with heaven and earth beads.

scenes.name: Story stage
scenes.description: Animated characters act out a problem before it is modelled.

scenes.name: Time line
scenes.description: Day, week, month and year strips with events.

objectives.objective: Subitise up to 5: see how many dots, fingers or objects there are without counting
objectives.visualModel: Dot cards, dice faces, five-frame flashes
objectives.masteryCheck: Flash 4 dots for 1 second; child says 4 without counting
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: A handful of dots appears for one second then hides. On replay, the dots slide into a familiar shape (a dice 4) so the eye sees the group at once.
objectives.interaction: Taps the number of fingers that matches the flash; can hold to see it again.

objectives.objective: Count objects one-to-one up to 10 and know the last number said tells how many (cardinality)
objectives.visualModel: Counters moved one at a time into a line
objectives.masteryCheck: After counting 8 bears, answers 'how many?' with 8 without recounting
objectives.animation: Each bear hops into a line as a number pops above it. On the last bear the number grows big and a lasso wraps the whole group: that number is how many.
objectives.interaction: Drags bears one by one into a line, then taps the total.

objectives.objective: Say the counting sequence to 20 and beyond; start counting from a number other than 1
objectives.masteryCheck: Counts on from 6 to 15 without restarting at 1
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: A frog hops along a numbered path, each square lighting up as it lands. Then it starts on 6 instead of 1 and carries on without going back.
objectives.interaction: Hops the frog forward from a given start number.

objectives.objective: Recognise numerals 0-10 and match each to a quantity
objectives.masteryCheck: Matches 7 to a set of seven objects
objectives.animation: A numeral card flies to the group with the same number of objects; the objects pulse once each as they are counted.
objectives.interaction: Drags numeral cards onto matching groups.

objectives.objective: Compare two groups up to 10: more, fewer, the same, by matching as well as counting
objectives.visualModel: Two rows of counters lined up side by side
objectives.masteryCheck: Says which row has more when one row is spread out wider
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: Two rows of cars line up one-to-one; the extra cars in the longer row are left without a partner and glow.
objectives.interaction: Pairs up objects between two rows to decide which has more.

objectives.objective: Find one more and one less than a number to 10
objectives.masteryCheck: Says one less than 7 is 6 instantly
objectives.animation: A cube staircase: one cube drops on top to make one more, then lifts off for one less; the step heights show the change.
objectives.interaction: Adds or removes one cube and names the new number.

objectives.objective: Understand that a quantity stays the same when it is moved or spread out (conservation)
objectives.visualModel: Counters rearranged in front of the child
objectives.masteryCheck: Knows 6 counters in a circle is still 6 without recounting
objectives.animation: Six counters in a line spread into a big circle and then squeeze into a tight clump, with the count 6 staying fixed above them.
objectives.interaction: Moves counters around, then predicts the number before checking.

objectives.objective: See numbers to 5 as made of smaller parts (part-whole): 5 is 4 and 1, 3 and 2
objectives.masteryCheck: Shows 5 as two parts in two different ways
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: Five counters sit in the whole circle, then slide apart into two part circles (4 and 1, then 3 and 2), then slide back together.
objectives.interaction: Splits 5 counters into two parts in different ways.

objectives.objective: Recall number bonds to 5 automatically
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers 'I have 2, how many more to make 5?' within 3 seconds
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: A five-frame shows 2 counters; the empty spaces glow and 3 ghost counters fade in to fill it.
objectives.interaction: Fills the empty spaces and says how many were missing.

objectives.objective: Recall some bonds to 10, including doubles to 5+5
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: Identical towers of counters appear side by side like a mirror image: double 4 is two matching rows of 4 on a ten-frame.
objectives.interaction: Builds doubles on a ten-frame and matches them to totals.

objectives.objective: Act out adding to and taking away from small groups in stories
objectives.masteryCheck: Solves '3 ducks, 2 more come, how many?' with objects
objectives.animation: Three ducks swim on a pond, two more paddle in, and the scene freezes into counters on a mat.
objectives.interaction: Acts out add-to and take-away stories with objects.

objectives.objective: Share objects fairly into equal groups and spot when a share is unfair
objectives.masteryCheck: Shares 6 grapes between 2 plates and checks they are fair
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: Grapes deal out one at a time to each plate in turn, round and round, until all are shared; plates are then compared side by side.
objectives.interaction: Deals objects onto plates and checks fairness.

objectives.objective: Explore odd and even by pairing objects
objectives.masteryCheck: Says 7 cubes cannot all be paired up
objectives.source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
objectives.animation: Socks pair up two by two in a line; with an odd number, one sock is left alone and wiggles.
objectives.interaction: Pairs objects and sorts numbers into 'all paired' or 'one left over'.

objectives.objective: Copy, continue and create repeating patterns (ABAB, ABB, ABC)
objectives.animation: Beads slide onto a string in a pattern; the repeating unit gets a soft bracket and then copies itself along the string.
objectives.interaction: Continues the pattern and creates their own.

objectives.objective: Name and describe familiar 2D and 3D shapes; build pictures from shapes
objectives.visualModel: Pattern blocks, tangram pieces, junk modelling
objectives.masteryCheck: Makes a house from a square and a triangle
objectives.animation: Shapes glide together to build a house; then one triangle flips and turns to fit a gap.
objectives.interaction: Drags shapes to fill a picture outline.

objectives.objective: Use position words: in front, behind, on top, under, next to, between
objectives.visualModel: Hide-and-find games, Bee-Bot style floor robot
objectives.masteryCheck: Places a toy between two others on instruction
objectives.animation: A cat moves on, under, behind and between boxes, and each position word lights up as the cat lands.
objectives.interaction: Moves the cat to the spoken position.

objectives.objective: Compare length, weight and capacity directly: longer, heavier, holds more
objectives.visualModel: Balance scale, cups of water, ribbons
objectives.masteryCheck: Uses a balance to say which of two objects is heavier
objectives.animation: Two objects drop onto a balance and it tips; two ribbons line up at the same starting edge to show which is longer.
objectives.interaction: Compares two objects on the balance or by lining them up.

objectives.objective: Sequence daily events with before, after, first, then, next
objectives.animation: Picture cards of the day slide into order on a timeline from sunrise to bedtime.

objectives.objective: Explain an idea in their own words when asked 'how do you know?'
objectives.masteryCheck: Gives a reason, not just an answer
objectives.animation: A friendly character shows an answer, then rewinds and shows how they know with objects.
objectives.interaction: Records a spoken or drawn 'how I know'.

objectives.objective: Count to and across 100, forwards and backwards, from any number
objectives.masteryCheck: Counts back from 63 to 48 without slips
objectives.animation: A spotlight walks across the hundred square; at 39 to 40 it jumps to the next row, showing the decade change. Then it walks backwards.
objectives.interaction: Counts forwards and backwards by tapping the next square.

objectives.objective: Count in 2s, 5s and 10s
objectives.animation: Pairs of shoes, hands of 5 and ten-frames appear in rows while the matching numbers on the hundred square light up in a pattern.
objectives.interaction: Taps the next number in the count and watches the pattern grow.

objectives.objective: Read and write numerals to 100 and number words to 20
objectives.animation: A number word floats up and morphs into its numeral, with the matching quantity in ten-frames below.

objectives.objective: See teen numbers as ten and some more (13 = 10 + 3)
objectives.visualModel: Full ten-frame plus loose counters, rekenrek
objectives.masteryCheck: Builds 16 as a full ten and 6 without counting in ones
objectives.animation: 13 counters fall in; ten fill one frame exactly and then glow as one block, and the extra 3 sit in the next frame. The label morphs: 10 and 3, then 13.
objectives.interaction: Builds teen numbers as a full ten and some more.

objectives.objective: Find one more and one less than any number to 100
objectives.animation: A number on the hundred square grows a +1 arrow to the right and a -1 arrow to the left, wrapping at row ends.
objectives.interaction: Taps one more and one less of a target number.

objectives.objective: Show numbers with objects and on a number line; use equal to, more than, less than, most, least
objectives.masteryCheck: Places 12 and 17 on a 0-20 line and says which is more
objectives.animation: Two towers of cubes slide onto a number line at their numbers; the taller one is further along.
objectives.interaction: Places numbers on a line and compares them.

objectives.objective: Subitise structured quantities up to 10 (ten-frame, dice, finger patterns)
objectives.animation: A ten-frame flashes 7 as a full row of 5 and 2 more; on replay the full row glows to show 5 and 2.
objectives.interaction: Says the flashed number and shows it on the bead frame in one push.

objectives.objective: Know all number bonds to 10 fluently, in both orders
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers 10 = 6 + ? within 3 seconds, for every pair
objectives.animation: A ten-frame holds 6 red; the 4 empty spaces fill with yellow. Then the frame flips through all bonds of 10 like a flip-book.
objectives.interaction: Fills the frame to 10 and finds the missing part.

objectives.objective: Know and derive number bonds within 20 (14 = 9 + 5)
objectives.animation: 9 and 5 sit on double ten-frames; one counter jumps across to fill the first ten, leaving 10 and 4.
objectives.interaction: Uses a known fact to solve a teen bond.

objectives.objective: Read, write and interpret statements using +, - and =
objectives.masteryCheck: Writes a number sentence for a picture story
objectives.animation: A picture story plays, then each object turns into a symbol: the groups become numbers, joining becomes +, the total becomes = and a number.
objectives.interaction: Builds a number sentence from a picture by dragging symbols.

objectives.objective: Add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers within 20, including zero
objectives.masteryCheck: Solves 15 - 7 with a strategy, not counting all
objectives.animation: 15 sits on ten-frames; 7 counters fly away, first 5 from the loose part, then 2 from the full ten.
objectives.interaction: Solves the problem on the model, then types it.

objectives.objective: Use the make-ten strategy to add across 10 (8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3)
objectives.visualModel: Two ten-frames, cherry split diagram (Japanese sakuranbo keisan)
objectives.animation: 8 and 5 sit on two frames. The 5 splits on a cherry diagram into 2 and 3; the 2 slides over to complete the ten; the full ten glows; the answer is 10 + 3 = 13.
objectives.interaction: Splits the second number on a cherry and drags the part that makes ten.

objectives.objective: Subtract back through 10 (13 - 5 = 13 - 3 - 2) or from 10 (13 - 5 = 10 - 5 + 3)
objectives.animation: 13 on frames. Take away 5: the 5 splits into 3 and 2; first 3 leave to reach exactly 10, then 2 more; a hop on the number line mirrors each step.
objectives.interaction: Splits the number to subtract and hops back to 10 first.

objectives.objective: Solve missing-number problems such as 7 = ? - 9
objectives.animation: A part-whole model with one part hidden behind a question mark; the whole and the known part pull apart to reveal the gap.
objectives.interaction: Finds the hidden part by moving counters.

objectives.objective: Understand = as 'has the same value as', not 'the answer comes next'
objectives.visualModel: Balance scale, equations written both ways round
objectives.animation: 5 + 3 sits on one pan and 8 on the other, and the beam levels. Then 4 + 4 replaces 8 and it stays level: both sides have the same value.
objectives.interaction: Loads both sides and makes the balance level.

objectives.objective: Solve one-step word problems by drawing them, including a simple bar model
objectives.masteryCheck: Draws a bar for 'Sam has 6, Ali has 3 more'
objectives.animation: Sam's 6 apples line up and shrink into a bar; Ali's apples line up beside them, longer by 3, and become a longer bar.
objectives.interaction: Draws bars from objects and labels the parts.

objectives.objective: Solve one-step multiplication and division problems using objects, pictures and arrays
objectives.masteryCheck: Makes 3 groups of 4 and finds the total
objectives.animation: Eggs drop into 3 rows of 4 in a box; each row lights up in turn as the count goes 4, 8, 12.

objectives.objective: Double and halve numbers to 20
objectives.animation: A mirror slides beside 7 counters and creates a copy; then a group of 14 splits down the middle into two equal halves.
objectives.interaction: Doubles with the mirror and halves by splitting.

objectives.objective: Recognise a half as one of two equal parts of a shape, object or quantity
objectives.masteryCheck: Says whether a shape is cut into halves or not
objectives.animation: A paper square folds in half; the two halves lie exactly on top of each other. An unequal cut does not match and wobbles.
objectives.interaction: Folds and cuts shapes, then checks if the parts match.

objectives.objective: Recognise a quarter as one of four equal parts
objectives.animation: A pizza is cut in half and then half again; four equal slices spread apart and one lights up.
objectives.interaction: Cuts shapes and groups into four equal parts.

objectives.objective: Compare, describe and measure length, mass, capacity and time, starting with non-standard units
objectives.masteryCheck: Measures a book in cubes and compares two books
objectives.animation: Cubes snap along a pencil one by one, counting up; the same cubes then measure a book.

objectives.objective: Recognise UK coins and notes and their values
objectives.animation: Coins grow to show their value as small stacks of 1p coins (5p becomes 5 pennies).
objectives.interaction: Sorts coins and picks a named coin.

objectives.objective: Know days of the week, months and seasons; sequence events
objectives.animation: A week strip rolls like a wheel; the days cycle back to Monday. Seasons orbit around a year circle.
objectives.interaction: Puts days and months in order on the wheel.

objectives.objective: Tell the time to the hour and half past; draw the hands
objectives.masteryCheck: Sets a clock to half past 3
objectives.animation: The minute hand sweeps a full circle while the hour hand steps to the next number; half past shows the minute hand painting half the face.
objectives.interaction: Turns the hands to the hour or half past.

objectives.objective: Recognise and name 2D shapes (rectangle, square, circle, triangle) and 3D shapes (cuboid, cube, pyramid, sphere)
objectives.masteryCheck: Finds the cube from a feely bag by touch
objectives.animation: A cube spins, then its faces peel off and lie flat as squares; a sphere rolls and a cube does not.
objectives.interaction: Sorts shapes and solids and matches faces.

objectives.objective: Describe position, direction and movement, including whole, half, quarter and three-quarter turns
objectives.masteryCheck: Turns a quarter turn on instruction
objectives.animation: An arrow turns quarter, half, three-quarter and whole turns, leaving a coloured sweep showing how much of the circle was turned.
objectives.interaction: Turns an object by the spoken amount.

objectives.objective: Spot and continue number patterns on a hundred square
objectives.animation: Counting in 5s paints the hundred square and the painted squares form two straight columns.

objectives.objective: Draw a picture of a problem and explain thinking using 'because'
objectives.masteryCheck: Explains an answer with a drawing
objectives.animation: A word problem is acted out; the scene freezes and is redrawn as a simple sketch beside the answer.
objectives.interaction: Draws the problem with simple shapes.

objectives.objective: Count in steps of 2, 3 and 5 from 0, and in 10s from any number
objectives.animation: A kangaroo hops in 3s along a number line, leaving jump arcs; counting in 10s from 23 slides straight down the hundred square.
objectives.interaction: Predicts where the next hop lands.

objectives.objective: Know the value of each digit in a two-digit number; partition in different ways (34 = 30 + 4 = 20 + 14)
objectives.visualModel: Base-10 blocks, place-value counters, arrow cards
objectives.animation: 34 is built from 3 rods and 4 cubes. One rod breaks into 10 cubes, making 2 rods and 14 cubes: still 34.
objectives.interaction: Builds a number and then partitions it a second way.

objectives.objective: Compare and order numbers to 100 using <, > and =
objectives.animation: 47 and 74 are built side by side; the rods line up first, so the side with more tens wins, whatever the ones.
objectives.interaction: Compares two numbers by building them, then places the < or > sign.

objectives.objective: Place and estimate numbers on a 0-100 number line
objectives.masteryCheck: Marks 70 roughly in the right place on a blank 0-100 line
objectives.animation: A 0-100 line zooms; halfway is marked 50, then the line splits into tenths; 70 slides into place.
objectives.interaction: Drags numbers onto an empty line and sees how close they are.

objectives.objective: Read and write numbers to 100 in words
objectives.animation: 'Sixty-eight' is spoken and builds 6 rods and 8 cubes as each part of the word is said.
objectives.interaction: Writes the word for a built number.

objectives.objective: Recall addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently; derive related facts to 100 (3 + 4 = 7 so 30 + 40 = 70)
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers 20 mixed facts in one minute
objectives.animation: 3 + 4 = 7 in cubes, then each cube grows into a ten rod: 30 + 40 = 70.
objectives.interaction: Turns a known fact into a tens fact.

objectives.objective: Add and subtract: 2-digit and 1-digit, 2-digit and tens, two 2-digit numbers, three 1-digit numbers
objectives.animation: 46 + 27: ones join to make 13; ten of them snap into a new rod (exchange) and move to the tens.
objectives.interaction: Adds and subtracts with blocks, doing the exchange by hand.

objectives.objective: Know addition is commutative and subtraction is not
objectives.masteryCheck: Says why 9 - 3 is not the same as 3 - 9
objectives.animation: 3 + 9 and 9 + 3 land on the same point of the line. 9 - 3 works, but 3 - 9 runs out of counters.
objectives.interaction: Tests whether swapping numbers changes the answer.

objectives.objective: Use inverse relationships and fact families to check calculations
objectives.animation: A part-whole triangle with 6, 8 and 14 spins to show four facts: two additions and two subtractions.
objectives.interaction: Writes all four facts from one picture.

objectives.objective: Know pairs of multiples of 10 that make 100 (70 + 30)
objectives.animation: Ten rods make 100; 7 rods slide left and 3 right, showing 70 + 30.

objectives.objective: Solve two-step word problems with a bar model (part-whole and comparison)
objectives.masteryCheck: Draws and solves a two-step comparison problem
objectives.animation: A two-step story plays; the bars build in two steps, the first answer feeding the second bar.
objectives.interaction: Builds a two-step bar model and labels the unknown.

objectives.objective: Recall the 2, 5 and 10 times tables; recognise odd and even numbers
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers mixed ×2, ×5, ×10 facts in 3 seconds each
objectives.animation: Hands of 5 appear one by one in a row while the count of 5s climbs; 2s light every other square.
objectives.interaction: Answers facts and sees the array for each one.

objectives.objective: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and arrays; know it is commutative
objectives.animation: 4 rows of 3 rotate a quarter turn to become 3 rows of 4; the total stays 12.
objectives.interaction: Builds an array and rotates it.

objectives.objective: Understand division as sharing and as grouping; write ×, ÷ and = statements
objectives.masteryCheck: Shows 12 ÷ 3 both as sharing and grouping
objectives.animation: 12 sweets share into 3 bags one at a time (sharing), then group into bags of 3 (grouping); both show 4.
objectives.interaction: Uses both sharing and grouping on the same problem.

objectives.objective: Solve multiplication and division problems in context
objectives.masteryCheck: Solves 'How many bags of 5 from 30 apples?'
objectives.animation: 30 apples drop into bags of 5, with each full bag counted 5, 10, 15 ...
objectives.interaction: Chooses grouping or sharing for a story.

objectives.objective: Know all times tables to 9 × 9 (Japanese kuku, Grade 2)
objectives.animation: 7 x 8 appears as an array split into 5 x 8 and 2 x 8; the parts glow and add.
objectives.interaction: Builds a times-table fact as an array and splits it into easier facts.

objectives.objective: Find and name 1/3, 1/4, 2/4 and 3/4 of a length, shape or set; know 2/4 = 1/2
objectives.animation: 12 counters arrange into 4 equal groups; 3 of the groups light up. Then a strip folds into quarters and 2/4 covers exactly 1/2.
objectives.interaction: Finds fractions of shapes and sets.

objectives.objective: Choose units and measure length (cm, m), mass (kg, g), temperature (°C) and capacity (l, ml)
objectives.masteryCheck: Reads a scale to the nearest labelled unit
objectives.animation: A ruler slides under an object from the 0 mark; the end lines up and the reading pops up. Scales and jugs work the same way.

objectives.objective: Compare and order lengths, mass and capacity using <, > and =
objectives.animation: Three jugs pour into identical glasses side by side so their heights can be compared.

objectives.objective: Use £ and p; combine coins to make amounts; find change
objectives.masteryCheck: Makes 37p in two ways; finds change from 50p
objectives.animation: 37p is built from coins; then 20p, 10p, 5p and 2p swap for other coins making the same total.
objectives.interaction: Pays an amount in two ways and gives change.

objectives.objective: Tell time to 5 minutes, including quarter past and quarter to; know minutes in an hour, hours in a day
objectives.animation: The minute hand sweeps in 5-minute jumps while a counter counts in 5s. Quarter past paints a quarter of the face.
objectives.interaction: Sets the clock to a spoken time.

objectives.objective: Describe 2D shapes by sides and vertical line symmetry
objectives.masteryCheck: Counts sides and finds the mirror line
objectives.animation: A mirror line slides across a shape; the shape folds over the line and matches exactly, or does not.
objectives.interaction: Finds lines of symmetry by folding.

objectives.objective: Describe 3D shapes by edges, vertices and faces
objectives.animation: A cube spins with its edges glowing one by one, then its vertices pulse, then its faces fill with colour.
objectives.interaction: Counts edges, vertices and faces by tapping them.

objectives.objective: Describe rotations as clockwise and anticlockwise turns; know a quarter turn is a right angle
objectives.masteryCheck: Turns a shape a quarter turn clockwise
objectives.animation: A shape turns clockwise like the clock hands; a quarter turn leaves a right-angle corner mark.

objectives.objective: Compose and split shapes; mentally rotate and fit shapes (tangrams, pentominoes)
objectives.animation: Tangram pieces fly into an outline; one piece spins and flips until it fits.

objectives.objective: Read and make tally charts, pictograms, block diagrams and tables
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers 'how many more' questions from a pictogram
objectives.animation: Pets walk into a pictogram row by row; tallies are scratched, then bundled into gates of 5.
objectives.interaction: Builds a pictogram from objects and answers questions.

objectives.objective: Solve missing-number sentences with a box as the unknown (? + 7 = 15)
objectives.animation: ? + 7 = 15 sits on a balance; 7 is taken from both sides and the box is left equal to 8.

objectives.objective: Reason about always / sometimes / never statements
objectives.masteryCheck: Decides 'odd + odd is always even' and shows why
objectives.animation: Odd towers (with one sticking-out cube) join in pairs; the two loose cubes always click together.

objectives.objective: Count in 4s, 8s, 50s and 100s; find 10 or 100 more or less
objectives.animation: A number gains 100 more: a hundred flat drops onto its blocks and only the hundreds digit changes.
objectives.interaction: Adds or takes 10 or 100 and sees which digit changes.

objectives.objective: Know place value in three-digit numbers; compare and order to 1000
objectives.masteryCheck: Shows 305 with counters and explains the zero
objectives.animation: 305 is built with 3 flats and 5 cubes; the empty tens column glows to show what the zero means.

objectives.objective: Read and write numbers to 1000 in numerals and words
objectives.animation: Each part of 'six hundred and eight' drops into its column.
objectives.interaction: Writes numbers from blocks and words.

objectives.objective: Show numbers to 1000 on a soroban (Japanese abacus)
objectives.animation: Beads flick up and down to set 472; the heaven bead counts 5.

objectives.objective: Add and subtract mentally: a three-digit number and ones, tens or hundreds
objectives.animation: 456 + 30: three rods slide in; only the tens column changes.
objectives.interaction: Solves mental additions with blocks shown faintly.

objectives.objective: Use column addition and subtraction up to three digits, with exchanging
objectives.visualModel: Place-value counters beside the written column
objectives.animation: 503 - 267: with no tens to exchange, a hundred flat breaks into ten rods and one rod breaks into ten ones. Each exchange appears in the written column at the same time.
objectives.interaction: Does the column method with counters synced to the written digits.

objectives.objective: Estimate answers and use inverse operations to check
objectives.animation: 298 slides to 300 and 405 to 400, and the estimate appears next to the exact answer.

objectives.objective: Solve missing-number and multi-step problems
objectives.animation: A multi-step problem builds bar by bar; the unknown is a question-marked bar.

objectives.objective: Recall the 3, 4 and 8 times tables
objectives.masteryCheck: Answers mixed ×3, ×4, ×8 facts in 3 seconds each
